prompt: Use case: style-transfer and conservative outpainting. ONE landscape 16:9 cinematic painting of the attached EDIT TARGET. Keep its complete original vertical field and widen naturally left and right, without cropping or stretching. Preserve all main narrative regions, distinctive people, cultural clothing, tools, creatures, architecture, tiny characteristic objects and relative scene geography. Refine photographic or CGI surfaces into fine restrained oil-painted material: subtle brush-built color planes, glazes, atmosphere and cinematic directional light. Fine strokes on faces/hands/instruments, somewhat broader marks on sky/water/masonry; no chunky paint filter or swirling expressionist sky. Keep original colors, no blanket orange/sepia. Preserve meaningful gestures, different facial identities and natural anatomy. Where source has multiple vignettes, keep every episode and use coherent painterly light and connected architecture/landscape, no added hard panel borders. No new giant portrait, labels, conceptual diagrams, logos, watermark or collage. Existing small inscriptions on objects remain natural. Retain original iconographic anatomy of deities, including canonical multiple arms when present; do not add accidental extra limbs. Preserve these characteristic original elements: 城市起源、河流、狼与英雄、神殿、诸神和地下区域，保留原画所有层次与标志道具。

refinementPrompt: Create one 16:9 horizontal museum-style illustration of Roman mythology by conservatively widening the attached panorama. Preserve its overall cinematic, finely painted style, palette, layered mountains/city/sea, and all principal narrative scenes. Extend the lateral landscape instead of cropping the top or bottom. Keep Aeneas carrying his elderly father from the distant burning city at upper left; the celestial Roman gods with their existing traditional robes and identifying objects across the top; sea voyages, ploughing and city foundations at right; the central protective she-wolf and TWO infant twins; underworld figures at lower left; household shrine, hearth, harvest and pastoral family scenes below; Roman arches, temples, birds and local tools. For the central infant twins, use simple modest linen tunics or swaddling cloth covering their torsos and hips while they sit safely beside the protective she-wolf. Retain the clearly recognizable wolf-and-twins founding legend through this clothed depiction. All other human figures wear modest period clothing; preserve their activities and distinctive faces. This is a dignified mythological museum panorama with no sexual or graphic violent content. Keep original small narrative details and natural anatomy; no new characters, giant text, labels, logo, watermark, panel frames or modern objects. Use subtle oil-painted material and atmospheric depth without a coarse filter; content and meaningful objects stay recognizable.
